quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #9
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 40

questions.question: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only a blood alcohol level greater than the legal limit can
Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
Only a blood alcohol level greater than 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Any amount of alcohol reduces your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory. Your driving skills will suffer. Drinking and driving is never safe.

questions.question: When a curb is painted ____, it means you can park there for only a short time.
questions.explanation: Painted curbs show parking rules. A green curb means you can park for a limited time. A nearby sign will tell you how long.

questions.question: You can drive in a High Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) lane if:

options.text: You are driving faster than other cars.
You are driving slower than other cars.
Your car has more than one person in it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your car has more than one person in it.
questions.explanation: Some highways have a left lane only for cars with two or more people. These HOV lanes are marked with signs and diamond shapes on the road.

questions.question: Drive slower than the posted speed limit when:

options.text: You are entering a highway with traffic.
You are on a four-lane road.

questions.explanation: Slow down when the road is wet, slippery, or you cannot see well. Slow down if anything makes conditions unsafe. You can be ticketed for speeding even within the posted limit if you drive too fast for the conditions.

questions.question: When changing lanes you should not:

options.text: Check your side and rearview mirrors.
Check for other cars moving into the same lane.
Use your cell phone to call the police about the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your cell phone to call the police about the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and look for other cars. Use your turn signal. Do not use your cell phone while driving.

questions.question: Drinking coffee after drinking alcohol:

options.text: Does not change your blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: Does not change your blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee does not lower your blood alcohol level. It may help you stay awake, but it cannot make you sober.

questions.question: When turning left onto a one-way street, you should turn into:

options.text: The lane closest to where you came from.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to where you came from.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane closest to the lane you were in. This is the safest way to turn.

questions.question: A railroad crossbuck sign should be treated like a yield sign.
questions.explanation: A railroad crossbuck sign is a yield sign. You must let any trains and railroad equipment pass first.

questions.question: Your speed does not affect how far your car travels after you brake.
questions.explanation: The faster you drive, the longer it takes to stop. Stay far behind the car in front of you on high-speed roads.

questions.question: If an oncoming car is heading toward you in your lane, you should:

options.text: Honk, steer right, and speed up.
Stay in your lane, honk, and brake.

questions.explanation: Honk to get the other driver's attention. If they do not move, steer right to escape. Do not swerve left, as the other car may correct and still hit you. Brake hard and steady. Slowing down reduces the crash impact.

questions.question: What is a diamond-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs are yellow warning signs. They warn you about dangers or special rules ahead. Orange diamond signs are used in work areas.

questions.question: At a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for cars behind you.
Move when the car ahead moves.
Look right, then left, then right again.
Look left, then right, then left again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look left, then right, then left again.
questions.explanation: Look left first because traffic from the left is closer to you. Then look right. Finally, look left again to catch any vehicles you may have missed.

questions.question: At night, when an oncoming car is approaching, your headlights should be:
questions.explanation: Do not use high beams when another car is coming toward you or when you are following another car. Switch to low beam to keep everyone safe.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.

questions.explanation: Drivers must make many decisions every mile. Any activity besides driving is a dangerous distraction and takes your focus away from the road.

questions.question: When crossing a railroad track without signals or gates, you should:

options.text: Have the right-of-way and don't need to check for trains.
Be able to pass slower drivers while crossing.
Make sure your vehicle can cross completely without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your vehicle can cross completely without stopping.
questions.explanation: Before crossing the tracks, check that you have enough room to get all the way across. Never pass another car at a railroad crossing. Always look for trains before crossing any tracks.

questions.question: What color are pavement markings that separate traffic moving in opposite directions?
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: If a crossing guard is directing traffic in a school zone, you must:

options.text: Do what other cars are doing, not what the guard says.
Assume the guard is not supposed to be there.

questions.explanation: Follow all directions from crossing guards and slow down in school zones. Always drive carefully when children are present.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the centerline means:
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass.

questions.question: You want to turn left at a green light, but oncoming traffic is heavy. You should:

options.text: Wait at the crosswalk for traffic to clear.
Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
Turn because you have a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
questions.explanation: You can enter the intersection to prepare for a left turn when the light is green. Wait in the center of the intersection until oncoming traffic passes, then complete your turn.

questions.question: You may cross solid yellow lines:

options.text: To pass traffic going the same direction.

questions.explanation: You can cross broken lines, but not solid lines. The only time you can cross a solid yellow line is when you are making a turn.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle if the line dividing your lane is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes going the same direction. You can cross broken white lines to pass if the passing lane is clear.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May continue through or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will exit the freeway. You can change lanes to continue through, or you must exit if you stay in that lane.

questions.question: You do not have to stop for a school bus with flashing red lights if it is on a private road.
questions.explanation: You must stop for a school bus with flashing red lights on any road, public or private.

questions.question: Your wheels slip off the edge of the road. You should:

options.text: Jerk the steering wheel to force the vehicle back onto the pavement.
Speed up and steer back onto the pavement gradually.
Slam on your brakes and stop.
Slow down with gentle braking. Turn the steering wheel to return to the pavement at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down with gentle braking. Turn the steering wheel to return to the pavement at a safe speed.
questions.explanation: If your wheels leave the road, gently apply the brakes to slow down. When at a safe speed, turn the steering wheel to return to the pavement. Do not sharply turn the wheel.

questions.question: When you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make sure they know you disapprove of their behavior.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and increase the distance between your vehicle and theirs. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or make rude gestures.

questions.question: When approaching a railroad crossing warning sign, you should:

options.text: Be prepared to stop if a train is nearby.
Look for a way around lowered gates.
Assume no trains are nearby and continue normally.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if a train is nearby.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you that a train may be coming. Obey all railroad crossing signs and never go around barriers.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, you must show:
questions.explanation: You must produce your license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance. You are required to have all three documents in your vehicle when driving.

questions.question: When approaching a flashing red traffic signal, you must:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Yield to traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when safe. At a railroad crossing, a flashing red light means a train is approaching. Wait until the lights stop flashing before crossing.

questions.question: You may cross a dashed white line:

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate lanes going the same direction. You can cross them to pass if it is safe.

questions.question: When other drivers are acting angry around you, you should:
questions.explanation: Distance yourself from angry drivers physically and mentally. Avoid eye contact and hand gestures. Slow down, move over, or do whatever you safely can to get away from danger.

questions.question: A good defensive driver:

options.text: Watches what other drivers are doing.
Drives at the same speed all the time.
Only drives on roads they know well.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watches what other drivers are doing.
questions.explanation: A defensive driver watches other drivers closely and expects problems before they happen. This helps prevent accidents.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a traffic light mean?

options.text: It is only used on one-way streets.
It means go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
You may only proceed if there is also a green circular light.
It shows the way to an airport.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go, but only in the direction the arrow points. Traffic in that lane must turn that way.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The bridge ahead is too low for tall vehicles.
Two lanes of opposite traffic are merging.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead is too low for tall vehicles.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the bridge ahead has limited space. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown.

questions.question: When passing a large truck, a driver in a small car should expect:

options.text: Strong wind pushes from the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Strong wind pushes from the truck.
questions.explanation: Large trucks create strong wind gusts that can push small cars sideways. Drivers should be ready to steer carefully when passing or driving near large trucks moving at high speeds.

questions.question: You should increase your distance from the car ahead when:

options.text: Driving behind a large truck that blocks your view.

questions.explanation: Increase your following distance when behind a large truck, in bad weather, in heavy traffic, when leaving a highway, when behind a motorcycle, or when someone is tailgating you.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should:

options.text: Use low beam headlights to see better.

questions.explanation: Fog makes it hard to see. Drive slowly and carefully. Do not use high beams—they reflect off the fog. Use low beams instead to light up the road.

questions.question: A slow-moving vehicle sign is:
questions.explanation: The slow-moving vehicle sign is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles with this sign are going 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: A car is coming toward you on the left, and a bicyclist is on your right. What should you do?

options.text: Let the car pass first, then pass the bicycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the car pass first, then pass the bicycle.
questions.explanation: When you face multiple hazards, deal with one at a time. Let the oncoming car pass safely, then pass the bicycle.

questions.question: To enter a freeway properly, you should:

options.text: Use your signal, let other cars go first, and match their speed.
Use your signal and enter. Freeway traffic must let you in.
Drive slowly to check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your signal, let other cars go first, and match their speed.
questions.explanation: When joining a freeway, signal first, let other traffic pass, and drive at the same speed as the traffic already on the freeway.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting. The road will split into two separate one-way roads. You must stay on the right side.

questions.question: Yellow lines divide traffic moving in opposite directions. True or False?
questions.explanation: Yellow lines divide traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: What affects your ability to stop?
questions.explanation: Road conditions greatly affect your ability to stop. Slow down on slippery or poor roads to keep control of your vehicle and be able to stop if needed.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, what must you do?

options.text: Slow down and keep moving in your lane
Pull to the right curb and stop

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right curb and stop
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights or hear a siren, immediately pull over to the right curb or side of the road and stop.

questions.question: Why does driving at night require extra caution?

options.text: There is more traffic at night
Drivers cannot see as well at night
Accidents happen more often at night

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers cannot see as well at night
questions.explanation: It is dark at night, so drivers cannot see as well. You must use your headlights from half an hour after sunset until half an hour before sunrise, or whenever vehicles and people are not visible from 500 feet away.

questions.question: Which has the right-of-way when a funeral procession is present?
questions.explanation: Drivers, pedestrians, and bicyclists must yield to funeral processions. When the first vehicle in the procession enters an intersection, all other procession vehicles may follow through, even if traffic signals say to stop.

questions.question: When making a turn, you must ____ your speed.
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed when turning. This lets you control your vehicle, stay in your lane, and react to surprises.

questions.question: If two drivers arrive at an open intersection at the same time, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver may continue without stopping
One driver should honk to give up the right-of-way

questions.explanation: If you reach an open intersection at the same time as a vehicle to your right, yield to that vehicle. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign warn about?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards ahead. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: When driving near heavy trucks, what must other drivers consider?

options.text: The increased stopping distance required by large vehicles
The decreased stopping distance required by large vehicles
The decreased noise of larger vehicles
The increased speed of larger vehicles

questions.correctAnswerText: The increased stopping distance required by large vehicles
questions.explanation: Large vehicles need more distance to stop. Stay where the truck driver can see you and where you can see traffic clearly.

questions.question: What is the correct way to use a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before entering the exit ramp
Slow down once you move onto the exit ramp
Keep your speed constant on the exit ramp
Pass slower traffic on the exit ramp

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down once you move onto the exit ramp
questions.explanation: Do not slow down until you enter the exit ramp. Then reduce your speed.
